source: Pew Research Center, Forum on Religion & Public Life. 2006. "Spirit and Power: A 10-Country Survey of Pentecostals."
method: Population is each country's general public sample (SAMPLE==1), excluding the renewalist oversample rows added to boost within-group analysis. Share coded "Pentecostal" or "Charismatic" on the survey's own RENEWALIST derived variable (vs. "Non-renewalist"); no missing values on this derived field within the general public sample. Weighted by the dataset's own GPWGT (general-public weight). Fielded May-September 2006 (see each country's own field dates in the topline); India's sample covers disproportionately Christian districts of three states and is not representative of India as a whole, per Pew's own note in the topline.
